items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I'll go along with it. Because I loved Oscar, you know, second to Blanton, solo wise.

ctx.x: I think he was with Alphonso Trent, I think. And then Oscar Pettiford had a brother that played tenor saxophone. I can't remember his first name, but he could really play. And you know, Oscar Pettiford was from Oklahoma and he was born on the reservation. Until his family moved to Minneapolis. They were all from Oklahoma.
Did you know Oscar at all?
